@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from .shell_completion import FishComplete
+from .shell_completion import split_arg_string
+
+
+class EmptyFishPartial(FishComplete):
+    """Fish completion that also removes an empty partial word."""
+
+    def get_completion_args(self) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+        cwords = split_arg_string(os.environ["COMP_WORDS"])
+        incomplete = os.environ["COMP_CWORD"]
+        args = cwords[1:]
+
+        if args and args[-1] == incomplete:
+            args.pop()
+
+        return args, incomplete
notes:
EmptyFishPartial inherits FishComplete and preserves its parsing, slicing, and return value, removing the final argument whenever it matches the partial word, including an empty match. No existing modules changed.
